field.label: Download from
field.help: Each download stream fetches this URL until the phase ends. Default: Cloudflare's speed test download (speed.cloudflare.com), which serves test data for this purpose; Cloudflare sees your public address and the test traffic. Cloudflare refuses requests above about 100 MB (HTTP 403, tested 2026-11-22), so the default asks for 90 MB and each stream starts again when it is done. Ex. https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=90000000, or a large file on a server of your own.

field.label: Upload to
field.help: Each upload stream POSTs zeros to this URL. Default: Cloudflare's speed test upload. Ex. https://speed.cloudflare.com/__up

field.label: Measure the delay to
field.help: One to five IPv4 addresses that answer ping, comma separated; the WAN gateway is always added. Defaults: 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare) and 9.9.9.9 (Quad9), plus the WAN gateway; as few third parties as gives a fair median. Add one of your own if a target limits ping. Ex. 1.1.1.1,9.9.9.9

field.label: Parallel streams
field.help: Streams per direction. 4 is what the RRUL test uses; more fills a fast line sooner. Ex. 4.

field.label: Seconds per loaded phase
field.help: Download, upload and both each run this long (idle is 10 s, cool-down 5 s). At least 10, because buffers take about that long to fill. Ex. 15 (about 70 s in total).

field.label: Cap the load at (Mbit/s)
field.help: 0 = no cap. A cap bounds the data used on a metered line; set it at or above your shaper rate (ex. the managed rate × 1.2), or the line never fills and the test shows too little delay.

field.label: Label for the next result
field.help: Kept with the result in the history. Ex. "shaper on, evening".
